# S.S Sand & Aggregates Supplier

> S.S Sand & Aggregates Supplier is Mumbai's largest and most trusted supplier of high-quality construction materials, including River Sand, M-Sand, Aggregates, Stone Chips, and GSB/filling materials.

## Products

- [River Sand](https://ss-sand-agg.vercel.app/#products): Premium natural river sand for plastering and masonry work.
- [M-Sand (Manufactured Sand)](https://ss-sand-agg.vercel.app/#products): High-quality manufactured sand for RCC and concrete applications.
- [Aggregates](https://ss-sand-agg.vercel.app/#products): High-strength crushed stone aggregates in 10mm, 20mm, and 40mm sizes.
- [Stone Chips](https://ss-sand-agg.vercel.app/#products): Clean, angular crushed stone chips designed for concrete and foundation bonding.
- [GSB & Filling Material](https://ss-sand-agg.vercel.app/#products): Granular sub-base and filling materials for road construction and civil infrastructure.

## Service Coverage

- **Primary Regions:** Mumbai (All Areas), Navi Mumbai, Thane, Western Suburbs, Central Suburbs, Eastern Suburbs.
- **Extended Coverage:** Kalyan-Dombivli, Vasai-Virar, Mira-Bhayandar, Panvel.

## Key Information

- **Minimum Order Quantity:** Starts from 1 truckload (approx. 10-12 cubic meters).
- **Delivery Timelines:** 24–48 hours across primary coverage regions; same-day delivery available based on stock.
- **Full Details:** For full context, product breakdown, and specs, see [llms-full.txt](https://ss-sand-agg.vercel.app/llms-full.txt).
